👉Living in Saipan | How Life Works on a US Island Near WWII's Largest Airbase https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=m0XCAISNRl8

On Kodiak, the year runs on dates that state and federal rules print: the herring opening at 9:00 a.m. on 1 April 2026, a summer salmon window, and a Tanner crab season that did not open at all in 2026. The film also sets two numbers side by side: a two-bedroom rent of $1,728 a month, utilities in (March 2026), second only to Bethel, and gasoline at $4.40 a gallon in January 2026, three cents under Los Angeles. If you lived here, would you call that a high price for an island this size, or about what you pay already? Say which, and say why. And tell us where you're watching from, and the biggest island you've ever stood on. 👇
